summary: Apollo V1 Iteration 15 — GATE 8 (Network + Account Protection) + Barking hero GIF + Gate-7 regression fix. Backend pytest test_gate8_account.py = 8/8 passed. Frontend acceptance PASSED end-to-end at mobile viewport 390x844 after onboarding-start-button → disclosure-accept-button. Home shows both home-check-network-button (Network Guard) + home-check-account-button (Account Guard) and apollo-hero-gif (patrolling) on a fresh state; after a barking event exists, hero switches to apollo-hero-gif-barking (accessibilityLabel 'Apollo barking') and hides apollo-hero-gif — barking-GIF spec confirmed. /network dashboard renders network-protection-title='Active', network-current='Connected via unknown', network-recent='No dangerous connections blocked · No unresolved network issues'. On the web preview the platform reports connection type='unknown' (not 'wifi'), so both network-ctx-public and network-ctx-home resolve to state='Patrolling', scenario=N01, verdict='Connected via unknown. Nothing worrying.' — this matches the spec's explicit web-preview note ('acceptable, just report'). network-tech toggles the technical sheet; network-again resets. /account dashboard shows 'All good / Patrolling' initially. Acceptance 3 (kind=mfa_prompt + provider=microsoft + initiated=no) → account-state='Barking', account-scenario='AC01', account-verdict="Don't approve this login. Someone may already know your password.", account-risk='Very high takeover risk', account-recovery-open visible; recovery picker exposes both 'I approved the login prompt' and 'I entered my password'. After reset, account-dashboard-title becomes '1 account needs attention' with an account-review-* Review button. Acceptance 6 (mfa_prompt + microsoft + initiated=yes) → state='Patrolling', scenario='AC20', no recovery button. AC15 (security_alert + google + phishing link 'https://google-security-check.com/verify') → state='Barking', scenario='AC15', account-links row shows pill 'Not Google's domain' and account-check-link-0 is present (navigates to /check). AC16 (security_alert + google + 'https://myaccount.google.com/notifications' + initiated=yes) → state='Ears up', scenario='AC16', account-links row shows pill 'Official domain'. Breach: account-breach-id='test@example.com' + account-breach-run → status pill 'Not connected', account-breach-detail="Breach intelligence isn't connected on this build. Apollo won't guess — you can check haveibeenpwned.com yourself." — matches HIBP-not-configured truthful behaviour. Cross-gate bank takeover (message → account): /message sender 'CommBank' + text 'CommBank: your account is locked. Verify now at https://commbank-secure-verify.top/login' → message-state='Barking' + message-check-account visible → navigates to /account?text=…&scent=… with account-text prefilled; running kind=mfa_prompt + provider=bank + initiated=no → account-state='Barking' with account-linked '• Connected to: Bank fraud message — claims to be CommBank (Threat Scent). These events may be connected — do not approve the login request.' Cross-gate /call → /account: call-ask-code + call-claim-bank + call-check → Barking C03 with call-check-account button navigating to /account?scent=… OK. Gate-7 regression fix VERIFIED: name='Bank Security Update' + source=browser + purpose=security + perms sms+accessibility+overlay → app-state='Barking', app-scenario='A03', and all 3 access rows (app-access-sms, app-access-accessibility, app-access-overlay) now correctly show 'More than it needs' — resolves the iteration_14 A2 labeling nuance. Regression smoke: /app-check, /device, /file, /scan, /check all load without red-screens. Backend endpoint POST /api/account/analyse returns malicious verdict for phishing.apollo.test with official=false and account.microsoft.com official=true; provider=google with google.com.evil.top → official=false; invalid local_state → 422; short device_id → 422; second_opinion=true → 200. POST /api/account/breach → 200 status='not_configured' with helpful detail (mentions haveibeenpwned); identifier='a' → 422. POST /api/patrol/events accepts category='account' (scenario AC01, claimed_brand=Microsoft).

integration_issues.flow: Home 'Connected events (Threat Scent)' card after message→account handoff
integration_issues.issue: After creating a linked message-Barking (Bank fraud) + account-Barking (AC01, bank) pair with a shared scent_id via ?scent= URL param, /account creates its event with scent_id=params.scent and account-linked text renders correctly, but the Home tab did NOT display the 'Connected events (Threat Scent)' card. buildScents() in threatScent.ts requires >=2 events with the SAME scent_id (line 57), which the message + account events should have. Possible causes: (a) home.tsx cached patrol events not refetched on focus after navigation from /account back to /(tabs)/home; (b) the message event's scent_id differs from account event's scent_id (message might set scent_id=event_id which is then passed as scent=… to /account — that should match); (c) buildScents rank/state filter excluding it. account-linked text and Patrol summary both correctly reflect 2 warnings, so the underlying data linkage works — this is purely a Home render/refresh issue. Not a blocker; barking hero-GIF + barking state pill on Home still fire correctly.

issues: Expected 'Ears up' + verdict 'You're on public Wi‑Fi. I'll keep a closer watch…' when network-ctx-public is chosen. On the web preview expo-network reports connection type='unknown' (not 'wifi'), so the engine correctly returns N01 Patrolling with 'Connected via unknown. Nothing worrying.' This matches the spec's explicit note ('acceptable, just report') and will resolve to the wifi-specific verdict on native builds where NetInfo reports wifi. Recording for completeness — not a bug.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Investigate why the Home 'Connected events (Threat Scent)' card does not appear after a fresh message→account handoff even though both events share a scent_id and account-linked text renders. Likely a stale patrol-events cache on the Home tab; refetch events on tab focus (e.g. useFocusEffect) or re-run buildScents after any navigation-back with new events. Non-blocking — everything else (barking hero-GIF, account-linked text on /account, Patrol totals, cross-gate handoff buttons) works as specified.
No other blocking issues. Ready to ship Gate 8 + barking GIF + Gate 7 fix.
critical_code_review_comments: account.tsx L84: event creation correctly reuses scent_id from URL param first, then falls back to linked event's scent_id/event_id, then null — matches the cross-gate Threat Scent linking model. Good.
account.tsx L137: account-scent-notice card only renders if recentLinked.length>0, so a fresh /account with no prior context stays clean — correct UX.

account.tsx L157: link pill logic uses r?.verdict==='malicious' → 'Confirmed dangerous', suspicious → 'Not X's domain', else 'Official domain' — mirrors the backend accountAnalyse.official flag. Solid.

ApolloHero.tsx L108-113: state==='resting' && animate → patrolling GIF; (state==='barking'||state==='biting') && animate → barking GIF; else logo.png. Clean binary swap using testID='apollo-hero-gif' vs 'apollo-hero-gif-barking' as spec requires.

threatScent.ts L57: `if (list.length < 2) continue;` correctly requires >=2 events per scent_id. Consider adding a small useFocusEffect in home.tsx that re-fetches patrol events so a fresh handoff appears without app relaunch (see integration issue above).

server.py Gate-8: POST /api/account/analyse validates local_state via Pydantic enum (422 on 'not_a_state' confirmed), device_id min-length (422 on 'short'), scrubs password: values before processing, and gracefully returns explanation=null when Gemini unavailable. POST /api/account/breach honestly returns status='not_configured' when HIBP_API_KEY is absent — matches the 'never pretends' principle.

backend URL host-suffix match for provider google correctly rejects 'google.com.evil.top' (attacker-controlled suffix) while allowing 'myaccount.google.com' — suffix-safe check verified in test_official_domain_match_is_suffix_safe.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 tests in test_gate8_account.py — account analyse link intel + official domain suffix-safety + password scrubbing + validation + second-opinion + breach truthful config + breach validation + patrol account category)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% functional. Home + Network + Account dashboards, Acceptances 3/6/AC15/AC16, breach card, cross-gate message→account (with prefill + Threat Scent linked text), cross-gate call→account, barking hero-GIF swap, Gate-7 regression fix (3 of 3 perms 'More than it needs'), and regression smoke (/app-check /device /file /scan /check) all PASS. One minor: Home 'Connected events (Threat Scent)' card not rendering after fresh handoff (see integration_issues). Web-preview network type = 'unknown' resolves to N01 Patrolling instead of wifi-specific Ears up — explicitly acceptable per spec.

seed_data_creation: Fresh device per browser session via onboarding-start-button → disclosure-accept-button. Ephemeral SecureCore mock device_ids. Backend tests use uuid-suffixed 'gate8dev…' device ids; not cleaned but harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: (1) Web preview reports expo-network connection type='unknown' (not 'wifi'), so /network scenarios that require wifi (public wifi Ears up, home wifi Patrolling with SSID) resolve to N01 Patrolling 'Connected via unknown'. This is expected — the wifi-specific verdicts fire on native builds. (2) After a message→account handoff, /account correctly reuses the incoming scent param and account-linked text confirms the Threat Scent link, but the Home tab's 'Connected events (Threat Scent)' card was not observed to render on the same session — likely a Home-tab cache refresh issue; not a data-integrity issue. (3) The message form's run button is testID='message-check' (not 'message-run'). The call form's run button is testID='call-check' (not 'call-run'). (4) Gate-7 regression fix confirmed: Bank Security Update from browser + purpose=security + sms/accessibility/overlay now flags all 3 as 'More than it needs' (resolves iteration_14 A2 labeling nuance). (5) Barking hero-GIF (apollo-hero-gif-barking) fires when any barking/biting event exists in patrol; otherwise apollo-hero-gif (patrolling GIF) shows. Both use expo-image with autoplay.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no critical bugs. Minor integration observation: Home 'Connected events' card requires buildScents() to see >=2 events with the same scent_id in the patrol events list. Live account-linked text confirms both events share a scent_id, so the render gap is most likely due to /(tabs)/home not refetching the patrol events list on focus after the cross-gate navigation returns. Adding a useFocusEffect that re-reads events (or subscribing to the event store) would fix it. Non-blocking.
